title: D2 InputError wire-shape spec
description: Schema for contracts/input-error/input-error.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of JSON property-name constants that govern the cross-language InputError wire shape ({field, errors: TKMessage[]}). D2.Shared.WireShapes.SourceGen reads it to emit InputErrorWireShape into D2.Shared.Result; tools/ts-codegen/src/input-error-emit.ts reads it to emit input-error.g.ts into @d2/result. The .NET InputError record (sealed record InputError(string Field, IReadOnlyList<TKMessage> Errors)) and the TS-side interface reference the spec-derived constants — wire-format drift on 'field'/'errors' is structurally impossible.

properties.description: Closed catalog of InputError wire-shape property-name constants. Each entry pins one JSON property name (e.g. 'field', 'errors').

constName.description: Public C# / TS constant identifier — UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Must be unique across the spec.

value.description: Wire-format JSON property name emitted on the InputError JSON object (e.g. 'field', 'errors'). Must be unique across the spec.

doc.description: XML <summary> / JSDoc text rendered on the emitted constant.
